_about: What the-agent-kit's session-start check suggests when a tool is missing. install.sh --setup (and --update, which runs it) merges this list into ~/.the-agent-kit/recommended.json by 'id': new items are added and changed ones replaced. To stop a reminder, add the id to "dismissed" in your copy (deleting the entry works too). Entries without an id are yours and are never touched. 'when': 'always', or 'web' for projects whose AGENTS.md block marks a web or user-facing platform. 'optional': true items are listed by install.sh --check only, never in the session reminder. Per tool, 'mcp', 'plugin', 'skill' or 'command' (a program on PATH) names what must be present; 'install_windows' replaces 'install' on Windows. 'since' and 'replaces' are for the merge only. Details: ~/.the-agent-kit/docs/environment-setup-prompt.md

claude.install: claude mcp add --transport http context7 https://mcp.context7.com/mcp --scope user --header "Authorization: Bearer <your-context7-key>"

antigravity.install: agy mcp add --header "Authorization: Bearer <your-context7-key>" context7 https://mcp.context7.com/mcp

items.name: Playwright CLI skill (drive the UI in a real browser)
replaces: Playwright MCP (drive the UI in a real browser)

antigravity.install: npm install -g @playwright/cli@latest && playwright-cli install --skills=agents -g, then add playwright-cli to the ~/.agents/skills entry's include_only list in ~/.gemini/config/skills.json

claude.install: claude mcp add chrome-devtools --scope user -- npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest

codex.install: codex mcp add chrome-devtools -- npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest
codex.install_windows: codex mcp add chrome-devtools -- npx.cmd -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest

antigravity.install: agy mcp add chrome-devtools -- npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest

claude.install: install the skill build from github.com/pbakaus/impeccable (not its plugin form)

antigravity.install: install the Antigravity build from github.com/pbakaus/impeccable into ~/.gemini/config/skills/

claude.install: copy skills/frontend-design from github.com/anthropics/skills into ~/.agents/skills/, then link it into ~/.claude/skills/ (steps in the environment setup prompt)

antigravity.install: copy skills/frontend-design from github.com/anthropics/skills into ~/.agents/skills/, then add frontend-design to the ~/.agents/skills entry's include_only list in ~/.gemini/config/skills.json

items.name: gitleaks (secret scan in the kit's pre-commit hook)

claude.install: brew install gitleaks (or a release binary from github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases)

codex.install: brew install gitleaks (or a release binary from github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases)

antigravity.install: brew install gitleaks (or a release binary from github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases)

items.name: superpowers (planning, TDD and review skill library)

claude.install: claude plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace && claude plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace --scope user

codex.install: codex plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace && codex plugin add superpowers@superpowers-marketplace

items.name: ponytail (minimalism ladder, run it at lite)

claude.install: claude plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail && claude plugin install ponytail@ponytail --scope user

codex.install: codex plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail && codex plugin add ponytail@ponytail
